en: Long pasted text and pasted Markdown/text files now appear as compact composer cards with full-text preview and removal. Cards survive draft restoration and send their complete content with your instructions.

On Windows, Copy as Markdown places a Markdown file and plain text on the clipboard. Apps that accept pasted files can show an attachment card; the destination app controls its display. If file copy is unavailable, plain text is copied.
zh: 长文本及粘贴的 Markdown、文本文件现在显示为紧凑卡片，可查看全文、移除并恢复草稿；发送时完整保留内容及补充指令。
Windows 下“复制为 Markdown”同时复制 Markdown 文件和纯文本，支持粘贴文件的应用可显示附件卡片；实际样式由接收应用决定，文件复制不可用时退回纯文本。
